subject: Ronaldo Nazario (R9)
title: R9: the haircut, the Golden Boot, the business

lines.vo: A Golden Boot, and a haircut he now calls horrible.
lines.footage: Ronaldo 2002 World Cup celebration, close-up of the shaved head with forelock

lines.vo: Ronaldo, R9, has two Ballon d'Or wins and a very busy business record.
lines.footage: Ronaldo with the Ballon d'Or, archive, clean award footage

lines.vo: In 2002 he wore a shaved head with one long forelock. In 2021 he apologised to the mothers whose sons copied it.
lines.footage: Ronaldo 2002 World Cup match, close-up of the hair, no burned-in captions

lines.vo: At that World Cup he scored eight goals, including both in the two-nil final against Germany. A Golden Boot, and a haircut that needed explaining.
lines.footage: 2002 World Cup final highlights, Ronaldo goals against Germany

lines.vo: At Barcelona in 1996-97 he scored forty-seven goals in forty-nine games. Forty-seven in forty-nine. His shooting was better than his hairstyling.
lines.footage: Ronaldo Barcelona 1996-97 goals compilation, clean feed

lines.vo: Then the business years: he bought fifty-one per cent of Real Valladolid. Three relegations and two promotions. A rollercoaster with a sports city in the brochure.
lines.footage: Real Valladolid stadium, relegation or away match archive, neutral shot

lines.vo: Cruzeiro: bought in December 2021, sold in April 2024. Still a quick finisher.
lines.footage: Cruzeiro stadium exterior, clean footage, no logos

facts_used: Shaved head with a lone forelock at the 2002 World Cup; called it horrible and apologised to mothers whose sons copied it (2021 interview) - https://www.notife.com/ronaldo-recordo-su-look-en-el-mundial-de-2002-y-pidio-disculpas
2002 World Cup: 8 goals, both in the 2-0 final v Germany, Golden Boot - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ronaldo_(Brazilian_footballer)

Real Valladolid: bought 51% for over $30m (2018); three relegations and two promotions under his ownership - https://www.infobae.com/deportes/2025/05/23/ronaldo-dejo-de-ser-propietario-del-valladolid-la-millonaria-cifra-por-la-que-vendio-sus-acciones/
Cruzeiro: bought control Dec 2021 (about $70m invested), sold April 2024 - https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ronaldo_(Brazilian_footballer)
notes: Hair and the haircut apology are his public image, not health. Valladolid and Cruzeiro are business facts, no legal or court content. The 'sports city' promise comes from Infobae's review of the club years. The 2002 line previously read 'eight goals, both in the final', which blurred the stat; it now says eight goals including both in the two-nil final, matching the source. The apology year (2021) is from the notife interview. Ronaldo's dispute over fake quotes (July 2026) and the Liv Drinks debt are excluded. The 'two promotions' figure is from one source (Infobae), so it should be checked again if the video goes out. Insert after_line values are 0-based.
